name: Marching Cubes Revisited
definition: A slightly modified version of the marching cubes algorithm for meshing implicit surfaces. It approximates the surface on a regular grid first, then uses a balanced octree. It places vertices at the center of the edge rather than using linear interpolation, to ensure topological correctness.
summary: Marching Cubes Revisited is a topologically correct isosurface extraction method that resolves face ambiguities via specific diagonal connections and edge-center placement to guarantee correct topology.
